attributes.name: torso_bent_forward
attributes.text: The torso bends forward from the hips.
attributes.definition: The spine leans clearly forward of the hips for part of the action, more than a slight lean.

attributes.name: head_bowed_down
attributes.text: The head is tilted down toward the hands.
attributes.definition: The head stays pitched forward and down, as when looking at the hands or the floor, for most of the action.

attributes.name: head_tilted_back
attributes.definition: The head pitches back so the face points upward for a moment.

attributes.name: head_tilted_sideways
attributes.text: The head leans toward one shoulder.
attributes.definition: The head rolls to one side so one ear moves closer to the shoulder, for at least part of the action.

attributes.name: seated
attributes.text: The person sits with hips low and thighs roughly level.
attributes.definition: For most of the clip the hips are at about knee height with knees bent and feet on the floor, without the torso being bent down to the floor.

attributes.name: deep_crouch
attributes.text: Knees and hips bend deeply with the feet flat.
attributes.definition: The hips drop close to the heels or knees while the feet stay on the floor, without a seat under the hips.

attributes.name: elbow_raised_high
attributes.text: An elbow is raised to shoulder height or above.
attributes.definition: The elbow joint is at or above the level of the shoulder joint while the hand works near the head.

attributes.name: arm_fully_straight
attributes.text: An arm is held fully straight at the elbow.
attributes.definition: The shoulder, elbow and wrist line up in a straight line for a clear part of the action.

attributes.name: one_foot_off_ground
attributes.text: One foot is lifted off the floor while the other supports.
attributes.definition: One foot joint rises clearly above floor level while the other leg holds the weight.

attributes.name: torso_twisted
attributes.text: The shoulders turn relative to the hips.
attributes.definition: The line between the shoulders rotates away from the line between the hips for part of the action.

attributes.name: torso_tilted_sideways
attributes.text: The torso leans to one side.
attributes.definition: The spine tilts left or right so one shoulder drops lower than the other.

attributes.name: shoulders_hunched
attributes.text: The shoulders round inward and the head drops.
attributes.definition: The shoulders move forward and together while the upper torso curls and the head lowers, held for a while.

attributes.name: body_ends_on_ground
attributes.text: The body ends low on the floor.
attributes.definition: At the end the hips are at floor level, kneeling, sitting on the floor or lying, and they stay there.
